main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). Pioneer Park Racecourse is set in the Central Highlands of Central Queensland, approximately 270km west of Rockhampton. The 1,700m oval features sweeping bends and a 350m home straight that is moderate by country QLD standards. The track produces a mild early-speed bias, favouring horses that can park on or near the pace. Genuine deep closers are at a disadvantage unless the pace collapses, but the 350m straight is long enough to allow pressers ('P') to sustain a finish. Track is generally well-drained on its sandy loam Central Highlands soil base but can turn heavy quickly with summer storm activity.
main_turf.post_bias: MODERATE INSIDE EDGE: Inside barriers (stalls 1-5) hold an edge in 1000m and 1200m sprints. At 1400-1600m, mid-draws (5-8) are competitive as horses balance up by the back straight. Wide draws (9+) lose significant momentum in sprint races where the first turn is critical.

handicapping_angles.emerald_100_feature: The Emerald 100 (BM65-70 level) is the centrepiece of the Emerald Jockey Club's feature carnival. Race quality elevates significantly; upgrade horses with proven regional benchmark form from Rockhampton, Townsville or Mackay (+3.5 pts class angle).
handicapping_angles.central_qld_shipper_angle: Rockhampton (ROCK) shippers dropping from Tier 2.5 Central QLD HQ into this Tier 3.5 Central Highlands circuit carry strong class edge. Also monitor Mackay and Townsville stable connections (e.g. Kylie Sherlock, Shane Fliedner). Upgrade provincial-form shippers +3.0 pts.
handicapping_angles.summer_storm_wet_track: Emerald's Central Highlands location makes it susceptible to fast-developing heavy tracks from Queensland summer storm activity. When the track flips to Heavy 8 or Heavy 9 mid-meeting, local mudlarkers with wet track PBs dominate. Watch for late market support as conditions shift.
handicapping_angles.typical_distances: Standard program covers 1000m, 1200m, 1400m and 1600m. Rarely extends beyond 1600m.
